title: Could Usain Bolt beat a T-Rex in a 100 m race?
caption: Could Usain Bolt beat a T-Rex over 100 m? We timed it. The T-Rex disagreed. ⚡🦖 #could #usainbolt #trex #dinosaur #100m #athletics #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Usain Bolt beat a T-Rex in a {100|one hundred} metre race? {{ev}}We looked at the evidence. ||0.25|| {{sci}}Scientifically. ||0.3|| {{long}}With a stopwatch.

In lane four: {{name}}Usain Bolt. {{h}}{1.95|One point nine five} metres of Jamaican sprinter. {{wr}}World record: {9.58|nine point five eight} seconds. {{gold}}Eight Olympic gold medals. ||0.4|| {{pose}}And one very famous pose.

In lane five: {{name}}Tyrannosaurus rex. {{len}}Twelve metres long. {{kg}}Around eight tonnes. {{bite}}An estimated bite force of {35,000|thirty five thousand} newtons. ||0.4|| {{arms}}And arms that are, mostly, decorative. ||0.3|| {{ext}}Last race: {66|sixty six} million years ago.

Zero to thirty metres. {{t}}The start. ||0.3|| {{gun}}Bang. ||0.4|| {{react}}Bolt reacts in {0.146|zero point one four six} seconds. {{rex}}The T-Rex has never heard a starting pistol, ||0.2|| {{roar}}and takes it personally. {{lead}}But measured nose first, it starts twelve metres ahead. ||0.3|| {{ahead}}After three seconds, the dinosaur is winning.

Thirty to eighty metres. {{t}}Top speed. {{bolt}}Bolt hits {44.7|forty four point seven} kilometres per hour. {{rex}}The T-Rex, according to its own bones, manages about nineteen. {{pass}}At around thirty five metres, Bolt takes the lead. ||0.4|| {{look}}He does not look back. ||0.3|| {{wise}}This is the correct decision.

Eighty to one hundred metres. {{t}}The finish. {{win}}Bolt crosses the line in {9.58|nine point five eight} seconds. ||0.3|| {{where}}The T-Rex is at sixty four metres, ||0.2|| {{lean}}attempting a dip finish with no arms. ||0.4|| {{photo}}The photo finish requires two photos.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Usain Bolt beat a T-Rex? ||0.8|| {{yes}}Yes. ||0.9|| {{by}}By almost seven seconds. {{but}}There is, however, one problem. ||0.4|| {{line}}The race ends at the finish line. ||0.4|| {{rex}}The T-Rex does not.
Who should we race next? {{c}}Tell us in the comments.
